The '''Imperial Detention Center''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orinackra]].

==Description==
The Detention Center was a vertical building built along the outcropping cliffs of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orinackra]]. There was no way that connected the main entrance to the outside world, except from a [[shuttle carrier]].

Inside, two main [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]]s traversed the height of the building: one served the low-security levels down to the command center (zero, two, four, and five); the other went up from the command center to the high-security blocks (five, three, and one), which were controlled from the inside.<ref name="briefing">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', ''Detention Center'' mission briefing.</ref><ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

Some parts of the facility were accessible by entering a combination of letters from the [[Atrisian script]] into [[code lock]]s.<ref name="WW" /> Other sections were closed by [[force field/Legends|Force fields]]. Corners around the facility were trapped with [[I.M. mine]]s.<ref name="DF" />

For some reason, stashes of supplies were hidden behind false walls.<ref name="guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>

===Layout===
[[File:Orinackra0L.png|thumb|Symbol of the zero level.]]
The first level of the facility included the shuttle carrier platform just outside the main gates. Behind them where several elevators and control rooms before the proper [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block. An underground shaft connected to the high-security elevator shaft led to the [[garbage compactor/Legends|garbage compactor]] infested by some [[Dianoga/Legends|Dianogas]].<ref name="guide" />

[[File:Orinackra1L.png|thumb|left|Symbol of the high-security first level.]]
The first level was accessible only via the high-security elevator. A large, guarded hall, with an adjacent control room where [[Imperial Officer/Legends|officer]]s held strategic meetings, led to the most important cellblock of the facility where [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] was held; doors opened by the means of a [[code lock]]. A maintenance door led to the sewer.<ref name="guide" />

[[File:Orinackra2L.png|thumb|Symbol of the second level.]]
The second level included only one cell, accessible through a code lock, the Officer of the level being responsible for its [[code key]], colored [[Color/Legends|blue]].<ref name="guide" />

[[File:Orinackra3L.png|thumb|left|Symbol of the high-security third level.]]
The third level, accessible via the high-security elevator, had two elevated cells, accessible via walkways; right under the walkways was a dark area trapped with mines. Again, the cells opened from a code lock, and Imperial Officers carried their code keys.<ref name="guide" />

[[File:Orinackra4L.png|thumb|Symbol of the fourth level.]]
The fourth level contained a cellblock of six cells; the cellblock was behind a hall blocked by a Force field. The Force field could be turned off temporarily either from a lever in a control room, or a corresponding level in a maintenance shaft over the other side.<ref name="guide" />

[[File:Orinackra5L.png|thumb|left|Symbol of the fifth level.]]
The fifth level included the command center, and it was the only place accessed by both elevators. It included several halls, blocked by force fields, and the prisoner execution chamber; beyond that was a room housing the red [[keycard]] accessing the maintenance room behind the elevator shaft.<ref name="guide" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained the Detention Center on the planet Orinackra.<ref name="DF" /> It belonged to the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] branch, and its staff made use of the [[Atrisian script]] on [[Computer_monitor/Legends|monitors]].<ref name="WW" />

[[File:CrixMadinePrison-DF.png|thumb|Crix Madine as a prisoner in a high-security first level cell of the Detention Center.]]
In the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Imperial defector Crix Madine was arrested aboard the ''[[Arc Hammer]]'' by [[Rom Mohc]], and immediately taken to Orinackra. He was held in the second level awaiting execution.<ref name="briefing" /> Earlier, he had provided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with information concerning the [[Dark Trooper Project|Dark Trooper project]].<ref name="DF" />

Rebel Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Orinackra|rescued]] Madine from the prison during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DF" />
==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mission_to_Orinackra.png|thumb||An unfinished screenshot of the Orinackra level featuring an area that was ultimately cut.]]
Orinackra and the Detention Center first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''.
